title: Build CS1 campus operations decision core
acceptance_criteria: Campus state snapshots use aggregate campus/building/time-window signals only and carry explicit source provenance, decision-time cutoffs, and readiness semantics
Shuttle planning recommends bounded seat/headway capacity from aggregate demand and fleet constraints while failing closed on malformed or insufficient inputs
Classroom allocation enforces capacity, accessibility, equipment, time-conflict, and campus constraints before optimizing soft utilization/energy/movement costs

Food operations chooses only operator-reviewed production targets from explicit demand scenarios, capacity, registered sensitivity weights, and actionable method eligibility; no automatic kitchen dispatch is permitted
Building energy operations converts aggregate occupancy into operator-review modes using explicit registered thresholds and never emits BMS commands or achieved energy/carbon/cost savings
Cross-domain portfolio keeps dining, mobility, classroom, occupancy, and energy effects as separate decision-support signals and never auto-executes university operations
No student identifiers, BUCard identifiers, scholarship data, or inferred individual movement profiles are accepted by the decision contracts
All outputs distinguish MODEL_ESTIMATE, POLICY_HEURISTIC, PUBLIC_SOURCE, and MEASURED_PILOT-style provenance without promoting unsupported impact claims
Missing or contradictory required evidence produces WITHHOLD or REVIEW_REQUIRED instead of a confident recommendation
Focused regression tests cover nominal, oversubscribed, malformed, conflicting, accessibility/equipment, insufficient-evidence, food eligibility, energy thresholds, and API orchestration cases
FastAPI exposes domain endpoints and one combined campus-operations planning endpoint without claiming live BMS, shuttle GPS, turnstile, Wi-Fi, POS, or registrar integrations

blocker.summary: CS1 role branch already has three open feature PRs, so implementation may proceed on the task branch but must not open a fourth role-targeted PR until a slot is freed.
blocker.evidence: Open CS1 feature PRs #68, #69, and #70 target role/cs1-decision-intelligence; repository policy caps open feature PRs per role at three. Existing exact-head CI is also queued on the required self-hosted macOS/ARM64 runner.
blocker.next_action: Keep the implementation isolated and verified on agent/api-product/cs1-campus-ops-core; open the feature PR only after a CS1 slot is freed, then require exact-head CI before merge.

notes: This task extends the existing food-focused CS1 decision intelligence into reusable campus operations without editing active food-core owned paths.

Food-ops and building-energy policy files added concurrently on the same task branch were reviewed and accepted into this task because they use the shared aggregate campus contract, retain explicit human review, and preserve the evidence boundary.
The combined API now supports campus state, shuttle, classroom, food operations, building energy, and cross-domain portfolio planning under one decision-time-aware contract.
The task deliberately avoids fabricating PMR, pilot outcomes, live telemetry, or achieved sustainability impact.
Campus operations are advisory decision support; irreversible operational execution remains outside this package.
